Rashi on Sotah 13a:10:1.english: His ears were heavy [yakkiran udneih] - His ears were too heavy to hear.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:10:2.hebrew: מאי האי - למה אינכם קוברין אותו?
Rashi on Sotah 13a:10:2.english: What is this? - Why are you not burying him?

Rashi on Sotah 13a:10:3.hebrew: שקיל גולפיה - מקל, כמו "גולפי טובי בלע" מאבימי בערכין (דף כב.):
Rashi on Sotah 13a:10:3.english: He took a rod - A stick, like [the expression] "he swallowed the rods of Tuvi" from Avimi in Arakhin (22a).

Rashi on Sotah 13a:12:1.hebrew: ואי לא איעסק ביה יוסף אחיו מי לא הוי מיעסקי ביה - כלומר, היאך הניחוהו אחיו ליוסף ליטול לו את השם לבדו של קבורת אביהם? וכי פרקו מעליהן העול ולא חשו לו? ואם לא נתעסק בו הוא, הם לא היו עסוקין בו? והכתיב "וישאו אותו בניו"! אלמא, אף הם היו עסוקין במשאו וקבורתו. ומסקנא: כתיב "אחרי קברו את אביו" — תלה הכתוב בו, שהוא היה עיקר הדבר:
Rashi on Sotah 13a:12:1.english: And if Joseph had not occupied himself with him, would his brothers not have been occupied with him? - That is to say: How did his brothers allow Joseph to take for himself alone the credit for the burial of their father? Had they cast off the yoke from themselves and not cared about him? And if he had not occupied himself with it, would they not have been occupied with it? But surely it is written, "And his sons carried him" (Genesis 50:13)! Evidently, they too were occupied with his carrying and burial. And the conclusion is: It is written, "After he had buried his father" (Genesis 50:14); the verse attributed it to him, because he was the main part of the matter.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:12:2.hebrew: אמרו - אחיו ביניהן: הניחו לו להתעסק בו כנגד כולנו:
Rashi on Sotah 13a:12:2.english: They said - His brothers [said] among themselves: Let him occupy himself with it on behalf of all of us.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:12:3.hebrew: כבודו - של אבינו, במלך יותר מבהדיוטות, שיוסף מלך הוא:
Rashi on Sotah 13a:12:3.english: His honor - Our father's [honor] is [enhanced] more through a king than through commoners, for Joseph is a king.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:13:1.english: They were occupied with the spoils - of Egypt:

Rashi on Sotah 13a:14:1.hebrew: כדי שיתברכו מימיו - תמיד. לפי שאין ארץ מצרים שותה ממי גשמים, אלא שכולה עשויה יאורים וחריצים מנילוס עד סוף המדינה כמה פרסאות, ונילוס עולה ומשקה ומתברך, וממלא אותן יאורים, ומשקין מהן השדות. והיינו דכתיב (זכריה י״ד:י״ז-י״ח) "והיה אם לא יעלה מכל משפחות וגו'... לא עליהם יהיה הגשם. ואם משפחת מצרים לא תעלה ולא תבא ולא עליהם" — ואין כתיב כאן "הגשם", אלא "ולא עליהם יהיה" — אותו נהר שהן שותין ממנו. ויונתן בן עוזיאל תרגם: "ולא עליהם תיסק נילוס":
Rashi on Sotah 13a:14:1.english: So that its waters would be blessed - Always. For the land of Egypt does not drink from rainwater; rather, it is entirely made up of canals and ditches, [extending] from the Nile to the end of the country, many parasangs. The Nile rises and waters [the land] and is blessed, and fills those canals, and the fields are irrigated from them. And this is what is written (Zechariah 14:17–18): "And it shall be that if any of the families [of the earth] does not go up, etc., there shall be no rain upon them. And if the family of Egypt does not go up and does not come, and not upon them…" Here it does not say "the rain," but rather "and not upon them shall there be" — that river from which they drink. And Yonatan ben Uziel translated: "And not upon them shall the Nile rise."

Rashi on Sotah 13a:15:1.hebrew: ויהי האחד מפיל הקורה וגו' - בתלמידי אלישע כתיב במלכים:
Rashi on Sotah 13a:15:1.english: And it was that one was felling the beam, etc. - This is written in Kings, regarding the disciples of Elisha.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:15:2.english: And it was borrowed - They lent it to him.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:15:3.hebrew: תלמידו של משה - ולא שלמד מפיו, אלא תורתו של משה למדו לאליהו:
Rashi on Sotah 13a:15:3.english: A student of Moses - And not that he learned from his mouth, but rather the Torah of Moses was taught to Elijah.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:16:1.hebrew: בקברניט של מלכים - בקברות של מלכים. ולשון יוני הוא:
Rashi on Sotah 13a:16:1.english: In the "kavarnit" of kings - In the burial places of kings; and it is a Greek expression.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:2:1.hebrew: מאי שנא מעיקרא - דאקדמינהו למצרים מקמי אחי יוסף. ומאי שנא לבסוף, דכתיב "הוא ואחיו", והדר "וכל העולים אתו":
Rashi on Sotah 13a:2:1.english: What is different at the beginning - That [Scripture] put the Egyptians before Joseph's brothers. And what is different at the end, that it is written "he and his brothers," and only afterward "and all who went up with him"?

Rashi on Sotah 13a:4:1.hebrew: וכי - דרך לאסוף אטדין ולעשות מהן גורן?
Rashi on Sotah 13a:4:1.english: And is it [the way] - to gather thornbushes and make a threshing floor from them?

Rashi on Sotah 13a:4:2.english: That they surround it with an atad - A fence of thorns.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:5:1.hebrew: שלשים וששה כתרים - י"ב נשיאים דישמעאל, וכ"ג אלופים נמנו בעשו. וא"ת כ"ה הן — תימן וקנז נמנו ב' פעמים; וא"ת קרח נמנה ב' פעמים — שני קרח הן: אחד מבני אליפז ואחד מבני אהליבמה. ומ"מ ל"ה הן, וכתרו של יוסף הרי ל"ו:
Rashi on Sotah 13a:5:1.english: Thirty-six crowns - [There are] twelve princes of Ishmael, and twenty-three chiefs who are enumerated among the descendants of Esau. And if you say that they are twenty-five — [because] Teman and Kenaz are counted twice; and if you say that Korah is counted twice — [there were] two [people named] Korah: one of the sons of Eliphaz and one of the sons of Oholibamah. In any case, they are thirty-five, and the crown of Joseph makes thirty-six.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:7:1.english: He was delaying - [Esau was delaying the burial,] so that they would not bury him there.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:7:2.hebrew: אמר - קרית ארבע שמה, שאינה מחזקת אלא ד' זוגות. הא דא"ר יצחק לאו מלתא דעשו היא, אלא גמרא קאמר ליה, למימר טעמא דעיכובא, דודאי כן הוה כדברי עשו, שאינה מחזקת אלא ח' קברים:
Rashi on Sotah 13a:7:2.english: He said - Its name is Kiriat Arba ["City of Four"], because it holds only four pairs. This statement of Rabbi Yitzchak is not a claim of Esau's; rather, he is stating it as a received tradition, to give the reason for the delay — that it was indeed so, as Esau said, that it held only eight graves.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:7:4.hebrew: קברה ללאה בדידיה - בחלק המגיעו, כדכתיב: ושמה קברתי את לאה:
Rashi on Sotah 13a:7:4.english: He buried Leah in his own [share] - In the portion that came to him, as it is written (Genesis 49:31): "And there I buried Leah."

Rashi on Sotah 13a:8:1.english: You sold it - When you sold the birthright.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:8:2.hebrew: נהי דזבינתי לבכורתי - ולא אטול פי שנים, אלא כמוהו:
Rashi on Sotah 13a:8:2.english: Granted that I sold my birthright - And I will not take a double portion, but only [a share] like his.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:8:3.hebrew: פשיטותא מי זביני - חלקי בחלק פשוט לא מכרתי:
Rashi on Sotah 13a:8:3.english: Did I sell the simple [portion]? - I did not sell my portion in the plain [i.e., simple, ordinary] share.

Rashi on Sotah 13a:8:4.hebrew: א"ל אין - פשיטותיך נמי זבנת חלקך במערה זו לגמרי, שכך אמר אבינו בשעת מיתה: ״אשר כריתי לי״, ואין ״כירה״ אלא לשון מכירה, כמו ״ואכרה לי בחמשה עשר כסף״ (הושע ג׳:ב׳):
Rashi on Sotah 13a:8:4.english: He said to them: Yes - Your simple [claim is]: you also sold your share in this cave entirely, for so our father said at the time of his death: "which I have dug [kariti] for myself" — and "kira" is nothing other than an expression of sale, as in "So I bought her [va'ekkereha] for myself for fifteen pieces of silver" (Hosea 3:2).

Rashi on Sotah 13a:9:1.english: Give me a document - Show the bill of sale.

Tosafot on Sotah 13a:14:1.hebrew: סרח בת אשר נשתיירה מאותו הדור - תימה: והלא מכיר ויאיר בן מנשה נולדו בימי יעקב, והיו מבאי הארץ; למה לא שאלם משה, והם היו מבני בניו של יוסף? י"ל: שסוד הגאולה נמסר לסרח, כדאיתא בפירקי ר"א (פרק מח). וכיון שבא משה, הלכו זקני ישראל אצלה, לפי שכבר נכשלו על ידי בני אפרים שיצאו שלשים שנה לפני הקץ, ונמלכו עתה בה. ואמרה להם: מה לשון אמר לכם המושיע הזה? אמרו לה: "פקוד פקדתי". אמרה להם: א"כ הוא הוא! לכך הלך גם משה אצלה. מתוספת רבי:
Tosafot on Sotah 13a:14:1.english: "Serach daughter of Asher, who remained from that generation" - This is puzzling: Weren't Machir and Yair, the sons of Manasseh, born in the days of Jacob, and among those who came into the Land? Why did Moses not ask them [where Joseph was buried], when they were among the grandchildren of Joseph? One can answer: The secret of the redemption was transmitted to Serach, as stated in Pirkei deRabbi Eliezer (chapter 48). And when Moses came, the elders of Israel went to her, since they had already stumbled through the sons of Ephraim, who left thirty years before the appointed end, and so they now consulted with her. And she said to them: What wording did this redeemer say to you? They said to her: "I have surely remembered [you]" (*pakod pakadti*). She said to them: If so, he is the one! That is why Moses, too, went to her. [This is] from the addition of Rabbi [Yehudah HaNasi].
